create_mvit_backbone: create an MViT backbone model with configurable image size, patch embedding, and depth parameters
build_multiscale_attention: build a MultiScaleAttention block with qkv pooling, window attention, and relative positional embeddings
configure_multiscale_block: configure a MultiScaleBlock with stochastic depth, MLP, and residual pooling for transformer layers
run_mvit_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the MViT backbone to extract multi-scale feature maps from scale2 to scale5
initialize_mvit_weights: initialize MViT model weights with trunc_normal_ for linear layers and constant scaling for layer normalization
